title: 'Perrin's Mother' (Reedholm, Fenmarch) and its payoff (Highward barracks, Wardmoor) sit on opposite ends of the map with no fast-travel bridge between hold-regions; once Perrin's fate was resolved at Wardmoor there was no practical way back to Reedholm within the turn budget, so a two-line, low-effort quest was left permanently incomplete purely due to geography, not difficulty.
